implementation: All temporal metadata, including orphaned or null fields, enters strict preflight instead of finite fallback.
Initial serial delivery requires source/compiler/paired identity, native engine, no predecessor, matching sequence identity and maximum ticks, a valid native graph and named stabilization node.
After controller start, attach the temporal clock and stabilization path before first execution; failed attachment cancels the workflow.

verification.negative: Cross-bound identity, malformed metadata, successor-as-initial, graph identity or duration mismatch and invalid graph are rejected.
verification.initial_fixture_failure: The first fixture had an unreachable failed terminal. A conditional checkpoint made both terminals reachable; the engine validator was preserved.

limitations: No Minecraft GameTests or live server execution performed.
No full temporal capability advertisement, successor polling, production route mount or packaged EXE build yet.
The test validates preflight and existing controller regressions, not a full HTTP-to-runtime acceptance journey.
